spans.s: विहार expansion of the position ( स्थान ) and the means of utter- ance ( करण ) of a sound beyond the necessary extent, which pro- duces a fault of pronunciation, called व्यास; cf. विहारसंहारयेाव्यासपीडने । स्थानकरणयोर्विहारे विस्तारे व्यासो नाम दोषो जायते Uvvaṭa on R. Pr. XIV 2.
विहित prescribed by a rule; that for which a vidhi or injunction has been laid down. The word is very frequently used by gram- marians with respect to an affix prescribed after a base.

विहितविशेषण an adjectival word gen- erally in a different case from that of the word to which it is applied as an adjective, and hence, trans- lated as 'prescribed after' and not as 'belonging to' cf. विहितविशेषणं धातुग्रहणम् । धातोर्यो विहित इति | M. Bh. on
